Choose your path. Build a custom legend by selecting one from each category for a fixed price.
The Departure (Choose Your Vessel):
Pick your base: The Spartan, The Elysian Fields, or The Oracle’s Bowl.
The Initiation (Command Your Titan Carving):
Select your power: Zeus, Apollo, Athena, Pan, or Artemis.
The Road of Trials (Equip Your Legendary Armor):
Add your side: Spartan Spears, Aegis Bites, or Shield Shards.
The Ultimate Boon (Sip Your Ambrosia Nectar):
Finish with your choice of signature Refresher, Slushie, or Dirty Soda.

items.description:
Do you have the soul of a Titan, or will you burn in the Underworld?
The Challenge:
Finish a "Vessel" (Gyro, Bowl, or Salad) loaded with Double Hades’ Style (Extra Medusa’s Embers Harissa + Pythia’s Peppers) plus a side of Medusa’s Stones (Spicy Cheese Curds) in under 10 minutes.
The Rewards (The Victor’s Spoils):
The Immortal Shoutout: Your photo goes on the "Wall of Heroes" (or your Instagram/TikTok story).
The Golden Drachma: An instant 50 Drachma bonus added to your Pantheon Club account.
The Cooling Boon: A free Hades’ Frost (Italian Ice) to soothe the "burn of the Styx."
